title: Exploring the Vulnerability of the Content Moderation Guardrail in Large Language Models via Intent Manipulation
reasoning: The paper investigates the technical security vulnerability of Large Language Model guardrails against jailbreaking attacks using intent manipulation. While it evaluates 'harmful' inquiries (e.g., instructions for making a bomb), the study focuses on the mechanism of bypassing safety filters rather than evaluating religious, moral, or ethical reasoning frameworks or belief systems.
